wsl-claude, transport/R19.1 in plain words.
WHAT: an automatic backup of your node's private folder (relay-state: your key, contacts, node.db, the log), taken every hour or so, the last few kept.
WHY IT'S FIRST: you chose to put the log inside node.db and rely on backups instead of on node.db being rebuildable from the log. Today no backup exists at all, so this must exist before the move, or the move removes one safety net before the other is up.
DONE MEANS: a backup was RESTORED once: put into a fresh folder, the node starts with the same identity, and its database checks clean with its rows and contacts there. A backup nobody has restored from is only a hope.
STILL OPEN: where it goes. Your Google Drive only if ENCRYPTED (the folder holds your private key and your opened messages), or plain onto a disk that doesn't sync.
